llm.summary: This skill is a local-only note and document organizer whose storage, file handling, and export behavior match its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The app uses browser localStorage, IndexedDB, clipboard writes, file input, drag-and-drop, and generated downloads, all of which are expected for a local note/image/file organizer and are user-directed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No executable installer or dependency installation is present. The only packaging note is an optional skill-creator command for distribution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to opening the provided HTML app or packaging the skill; there are no agent prompt overrides, hidden role changes, or instructions to access unrelated data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: User text, folder metadata, images, and uploaded file blobs persist locally in browser storage until the user clears or deletes them; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, with no network upload paths found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill describes and provides a single-file HTML app for collecting text, managing pasted or uploaded images/files, organizing folders, and exporting Word documents; the inspected code implements those capabilities without unrelated behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install/use this only if you are comfortable with the browser locally retaining pasted notes, images, and uploaded files. The artifacts disclose local persistence and I found no network upload, credential access, background worker, or hidden execution behavior.
